idea: A night-shift nurse catches her reflection in the elevator doors and whispers: "I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm not fine."
A man in a flour-dusted apron waits outside a dark bakery and says: "I said I'd be here at 3 a.m., and I am."
An old fisherman talks to the empty seat beside him on the pier: "Margaret, the tide came in early today."
A teenager holds up her brother's cracked phone and asks: "Did you really think I wouldn't find out?"
A street musician's guitar string snaps mid-song; he laughs and shouts: "That's the best thing that's happened all week!"
A widow finds a letter she never sent and reads it aloud: “I should have stayed — I know that now.”
A lighthouse keeper records a message on an old cassette: "If anyone finds this, the light kept burning every night, even when nobody came home."
A retired astronaut watches a child launch a paper rocket in the park and quietly gives it a countdown.
A chef tastes her late mother's soup recipe for the first time in twenty years.
Two strangers share an umbrella at a bus stop, and one of them slowly realises they went to school together.
